title: Blinking LED Breadboard Circuit
description: A working blink circuit on a real breadboard layout -- with a button that removes one jumper wire and kills it.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Physical Computing and Electrical Safety Basics

educational.audience: Students building their first physical-computing circuit

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a breadboard, resistor, LED, and jumper wires, the learner demonstrates how they combine into a working blinking-light circuit.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Slider sets the blink interval; a switch drives the output pin by hand; a button removes the ground-return jumper
pedagogical.assessment: Break the loop and ask the learner to predict the LED current before looking at the readout.
